decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY establishing a two-row, four-badges-per-row layout; the badge-set decision requires no additional layout update.
Changing the approved badge set does not alter the requirement that permanent badges remain visible in NFT metadata.
Removing Legend and confirming an eight-badge set does not change the rule that earned badges transfer with NFT ownership.
The badge-set decision does not affect ebook access links, book-cover sizing, or NFT asset rendering.
The About page mentions badges only as a general feature and does not enumerate Legend, First Mint, First Referral, or a badge count.
The FAQ describes badge purpose and referral milestones generically; the approved badge names and count do not make its current copy stale.
The Mission page refers generally to badges, leaderboards, and achievements without specifying the changed badge set.
The badge-set decision does not change which successfully minted NFTs should appear on the dashboard.
Badge composition is independent of secondary-sale royalty amounts, destinations, standards, and enforcement controls.
The landing-page hero state contains no badge-set content affected by removal of Legend or replacement of First Mint.
The approved badge set does not alter prize-ticket issuance, weighting, eligibility, or expiration rules.
The badge-set decision does not change mint price or allocation among the founder, affiliate, and prize pool.
